title.narrative: SME Trade Finance Facility (STFF): Trade Finance and Investment Climate Support for SMEs in LDCs

description.narrative: The Project Initiation Plan (PIP) for the SME Trade Finance Facility (STFF) aims to address the trade finance gap faced by SMEs in least developed and developing countries within the African, Caribbean, and Pacific (ACP) community. The initiative supports importers and exporters needing financial assistance and is a collaboration between the UN Capital Development Fund (UNCDF), the European Commission (EC), and the Organization of African, Caribbean, and Pacific States (OACPS). The EC has allocated $11.8 million to launch the STFF. The inception phase involves market diagnostics in ten preselected countries, including desk research and deep-dive analyses to identify enablers and barriers for SMEs in accessing trade finance, assess financial service providers, and understand gender-specific constraints. The phase will conclude with the recommendation and selection of up to two focus countries for the implementation phase, ensuring alignment with national development strategies and supportive stakeholders.
